1:1: The pinned SBLGNT text used by DGT does not include the words “Son of God” in Mark 1:1; DGT follows that Greek text rather than supplying the longer reading.
1:41: The pinned SBLGNT text reads ὀργισθεὶς (“moved with anger”) here. Many manuscripts instead have σπλαγχνισθείς (“moved with compassion”); DGT translates the pinned SBLGNT reading.
7:17: SBLGNT does not contain the verse traditionally numbered Mark 7:16; DGT follows the pinned SBLGNT text and numbering.
9:45: SBLGNT does not contain the verses traditionally numbered Mark 9:44 and Mark 9:46; DGT follows the pinned SBLGNT text and numbering.
11:27: SBLGNT does not contain the verse traditionally numbered Mark 11:26; DGT follows the pinned SBLGNT text and numbering.
15:29: SBLGNT does not contain the verse traditionally numbered Mark 15:28; DGT follows the pinned SBLGNT text and numbering.
16:8: The pinned SBLGNT text brackets both the shorter ending following Mark 16:8 and the traditional longer ending in Mark 16:9–20, marking these endings as textually disputed. DGT preserves and translates the bracketed text rather than silently choosing an ending.
16:9: Mark 16:9–20 is bracketed in the pinned SBLGNT text as textually disputed. DGT preserves and translates the bracketed longer ending.
